semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Solinide Photonics AB develops optical microcombs that enhance data transmission in AI datacenters, which indirectly supports semiconductor applications.
summary: Solinide Photonics AB, a spinoff from Chalmers University, specializes in silicon nitride optical microcombs that consolidate multiple lasers into a single chip for improved efficiency in AI datacenter interconnects. Their technology aims to reduce power consumption and component complexity in optical systems.
capabilities: Energy-efficient optical solutions for AI datacenters

regional_presence.Sweden: The company is based in Gothenburg, Sweden, and leverages research from Chalmers University.
